title: @dylan522p — 2025-07-03
author: @dylan522p (Dylan Patel)
compiled_truth:
My hearing has been messed up for 3 weeks, felt pressure and hearing impacted.
I went to two normal doctors, took afrin, Flonase, antibiotic ear drops, and steroids to fix it.
Finally went to a specialist, this lovely 65 year old Dr. Sloan who retires in two weeks.
He froze my ear drums and poked a hole in them.
He explained everything about my ears to me and what happened.
He knew exactly what was wrong immediately and acted.
The banter was awesome too.
Old doctors are the best, they have such intuition and are so nice and fun.
Urgent care younger doctors are so soulless in comparison.
